column2: Volt set the scooter's clock right before this test, so the scooter may not be keeping the time it's given. Until that's solved, a smart plug is a safer timer. Report an issue with diagnostics so we can look into it.
column3: Volt asetti potkulaudan kellon juuri ennen tätä testiä, joten potkulauta ei ehkä pidä sille annettua aikaa. Kunnes tämä on ratkaistu, älypistorasia on turvallisempi ajastin. Ilmoita ongelmasta diagnostiikkatietojen kanssa, jotta voimme selvittää asiaa.
column4: Volt set the scooter's clock just before this test, so the scooter perhaps does not keep the time given to it. Until this is resolved, a smart plug is the safer timer. Report the problem with diagnostic data, so that we can look into the matter.
